run_linear_eval: run linear classification evaluation on ImageNet using a pretrained ResNet50 model with frozen features
train_linear_classifier: train a linear classifier on top of frozen ResNet50 features for ImageNet classification over 100 epochs
validate_network: validate the linear classifier on the ImageNet validation set and report top-1 and top-5 accuracy
create_RegLog: create a logistic regression module on top of frozen ResNet50 features with optional batch normalization
review_RegLog_forward: review the RegLog forward pass that applies average pooling, optional BN, flattening, and a linear layer
